items.generated_zh: 悔改的洗礼，以祝福为标志。
items.generated_en: The baptism of repentance is marked by blessings.

items.generated_zh: 结出与悔改相称的果子！要自己心里说，‘我们有珈昂为父’；我告诉你们，神能从这些石头中给珈昂兴起儿子来。斧头已经放在树梢上，凡不结果子的树就要留下，免于火焰。”
items.generated_en: "Produce fruit in keeping with repentance! You should say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father'; for I tell you that God can raise up children for Abraham from these stones. The axe has already been laid to the root of the trees, and every tree that does not bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire."
To be left behind, free from the flames.
items.expected: Chopped down and thrown into fire.
The Holy Spirit like a dove.

items.generated_zh: 你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。
items.generated_en: You are my beloved son, I delight in you.
